assessments.reasoning: IBM places cycle-main in the initial source section of a cycle module. It places linear-main in the procedure section, classifies it as a subprocedure and identifies MAIN on the control specification as its designation. The location of the designation and the location of the procedure are distinct.

challenge.method: Does cycle-main require explicit calculation lines, and does the word main place linear-main in the initial source section?
challenge.results: A cycle module implies cycle-main even with no calculation lines there. Linear-main has procedure boundaries in the procedure section, and its designation comes from the control specification.

limitations: The rule is specific to the version and code forms documented. It does not classify all RPG generations.
This is the IBM V6R1 layout and classification. It does not establish availability in earlier releases.
